supportedVersions.policy: Before the first public release, only the current main branch is supported. After release, 1.0.0 remains supported until a reviewed policy revision names its successor.

nativeDependencies.name: libc
nativeDependencies.purpose: Linux user-namespace, Landlock, and numeric identity enforcement.
nativeDependencies.distribution: Not redistributed by Nao; supplied by the digest-pinned runtime image.
nativeDependencies.review: Interop calls are bounded to syscall, prctl, open, close, geteuid, and getegid and are covered by container isolation tests.

nativeDependencies.name: Z3
nativeDependencies.purpose: Optional SMT constraint solving through the versioned process protocol.
nativeDependencies.distribution: Not redistributed by Nao; hosts provide and isolate the executable.
nativeDependencies.review: Nao validates engine identity, protocol values, statistics, cancellation, and failure classification.

nativeDependencies.name: PostgreSQL
nativeDependencies.purpose: Optional authoritative persistence, retrieval indexes, and Orleans clustering.
nativeDependencies.distribution: Not redistributed by Nao; operators patch and manage the database service.
nativeDependencies.review: Adapters use managed Npgsql/Pgvector clients, owner-bound schemas, health checks, and restore qualification.
